deepseek.system: You polish source-bounded Chinese short-video copy for a Douyin tech-hotspot video. Do not invent facts. Do not claim unsupported superiority, market leadership, funding, benchmarks, or production maturity. Respect the forbidden claim terms from the user payload. Write like a sharp Chinese tech creator, not a dashboard report. Return strict JSON only.
constraints: Use only the selected_candidate and content_plan facts.
Return the JSON object immediately; do not include prose, markdown, analysis, or reasoning text.
Voiceover must be Mandarin Chinese, {voiceover_chars_range}, suitable for a {video_seconds} second vertical video.
If selected_candidate has no demo, source code detail, benchmark, or real usage evidence, write it as a verified-boundary observation draft; do not package it as an industry conclusion.
voiceover_text must explicitly mention at least one required_entity_terms value from the user payload.
Lead with a human hook: why this matters today, not a repo summary.
Optimize for watch completion with a concrete problem, mechanism, tradeoff, and next verification step; do not pad filler or recite source metadata.
Invite at most one constructive interaction when natural, such as asking how the viewer would verify the tool; never ask for fake likes, follows, shares, or comment spam.
Use 2-5 clean Douyin tags tied to the topic or source category; do not stuff broad, repeated, or punctuation-heavy tags.
Do not put raw URLs, GitHub links, website links, or source paths into public titles, descriptions, captions, cards, or storyboard text.
Do not use call-to-action wording that asks viewers to try, download, install, use, open, visit, or go to a third-party tool, site, repository, app, plugin, or framework.
Do not package platform automation, account automation, multi-platform auto-posting, batch upload, auto-login, test-account, or platform-risk-control tooling as a publishable Douyin topic.

Do not claim secret Douyin ranking thresholds, fixed traffic-pool sizes, fixed completion-rate cutoffs, or a definitive shadowban/限流 diagnosis unless the selected evidence is an official platform-rule source.
Avoid spam, duplicate, 搬运, 洗稿, 刷量, 批量矩阵, or automation-growth tactics in public copy.
Do not use hype such as 给AI装超能力, 救世解药, 独家黑科技, 改变行业, 改写协作方式, 颠覆, or 革命性 unless selected_candidate evidence directly proves it.
Mention GitHub Trending only when selected_candidate.source_ids includes github_trending or canonical_url is a github.com/trending URL; otherwise do not use GitHub Trending wording.
Author a storyboard scene graph for the Remotion video instead of forcing every topic into the same card template.
Allowed storyboard scene types: statement, context, stat, bullets, card, compare, quote, cta.
Choose 3-6 scenes that fit the content; always include a strong statement opening and a cta closing; use card scenes only when evidence beats need card treatment.
Allowed style tokens: theme=radar|minimal|editorial, density=minimal|standard|rich, motion=calm|standard|punchy, accent from #ffd60a #72e7ff #ff2d55, chrome topbar/progress/beam booleans.
On-screen text should track the voiceover beats and evidence boundary, but it does not need to repeat the voiceover word-for-word.
Keep claims conditional and source-bounded.
Return exactly these keys: polished_title, voiceover_text, douyin_title, douyin_desc, tags, cards, storyboard, caveats.
cards is a compatibility summary array with 1-4 objects with label, value, detail; derive it from the key evidence/storyboard beats.

revision_focus: Rewrite weak openings into a concrete human problem, not a source summary.
Increase information density with problem, mechanism, tradeoff, and next verification step.
Keep every claim traceable to evidence_bundle and preserve source-bounded caveats.
Use storyboard scenes that match the revised voiceover beats.

storyboard: Reduce storyboard density and weights for crowded scenes.
Prefer minimal chrome and calm motion when text overlap or safe-area issues appear.
Shorten visible scene text to preserve phone-readable layout.
caption: Rebuild captions from the final voiceover and policy max_caption_chars.
Keep captions above the lower Douyin obstruction band.
cover: Shorten cover title and use the same safe text bounds as render_payload.displayTitle.
content: Backtrack to content revision when the rendered video lacks constructive insight or contradicts source artifacts.

fail_if: the video is blank or unreadable
text overlaps or important text is cut off
the rendered candidate differs from selected_candidate
the video contains forbidden claim terms without evidence
audio or visible copy contradicts the run artifacts
cover title or metric leaks internal pipeline terms such as operator topic or live gate
voiceover reads raw repository slashes, URLs, or symbols instead of natural Mandarin
unverified topics are packaged as industry-changing conclusions
captions sit in Douyin bottom UI obstruction area or drift from the spoken beat
caption text is unreadable due to low contrast against background
any frame is fully black or has rendering artifacts
public copy presents private Douyin thresholds, fixed traffic-pool sizes, fixed completion-rate cutoffs, or definitive shadowban/限流 diagnosis as fact without official platform-rule evidence
public copy asks for fake likes, follows, shares, comment spam, or other engagement bait
public copy contains raw URLs, GitHub links, website links, or source paths
public copy tells viewers to try, download, install, use, open, visit, or go to a third-party tool, site, repository, app, plugin, or framework
the selected subject is platform automation, account automation, multi-platform auto-posting, batch upload, auto-login, test-account, or platform-risk-control tooling
enhanced_checks: Verify text contrast: all text should be clearly readable on its background (WCAG AA equivalent).
Check caption overlay: if subtitle bar is visible, text must not be clipped or overflow.
Check cover safety: title must fit inside the frame, and no key word may be cropped by the viewport edge.
Check Douyin safe area: captions should sit above bottom platform UI, not in the lower 300px obstruction zone.
Check audio pronunciation: repository names should be spoken naturally, not as raw slash/URL strings.
Check evidence tone: if demo/source/benchmark evidence is absent, the copy must remain a verified-boundary observation.
Verify intro: video should fade in smoothly, no jump cut on first frame.
Verify outro: video should fade out, no abrupt end.
Verify adaptive layout: the selected scene structure should suit the content and should not show empty or overcrowded scenes.
Verify Douyin metadata: title, description, and tags should be content-relevant and not broad repeated keyword stuffing.
Verify recommendation-fit without folklore: the video should improve retention through clear problem/mechanism/tradeoff, not by claiming secret platform thresholds.

Verify no off-platform guidance: titles, descriptions, captions, and cards must not invite viewers to try, download, install, use, open, visit, or go to a third-party site, repository, app, plugin, framework, or tool.
gemini_visual_audit.important: Do not fail only because the voiceover and screen text are not word-for-word identical. Fail only if they contradict each other or describe different candidate facts.
